annotations.title: Resolution needed for a print or screen

description: Converts a print size (cm) and dpi, or a pixel width, into the pixels needed on the long edge and the fitting quality level, with the largest print each level allows at 300 and 150 dpi. Use for brochures, boards, site hoardings, websites.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

long_edge_px.description: Or: pixels needed on the long edge, e.g. 1920
